about: The thresholds of v1's detector: eta = lambda times each axis's median scale, sqrt(median(v^2) - median(v)^2), or 0 when that is not positive, over the velocity at every sample the mask leaves usable -- the two zero-filled samples at each edge, and any whose five-sample window touches a masked sample, included. A sample is in an event when (vx/eta_x)^2 + (vy/eta_y)^2 > 1. v1_traces gives each v1 trace's [eta_x, eta_y] in deg/s; the near-threshold traces, at v1's fs_hz, move at speeds close to the ellipse, so lambda off by 5% or a limit above 1 changes their runs. A run is [start, stop) in samples; amplitude_deg is np.hypot, which C libraries round differently in the last place. Never edited.
